=== README.md (md) === ## Advanced coding ## **Course Description** This three-credit course will introduce students to effective, data-driven interactive storytelling. Students will learn how to effectively research and pitch stories; they will learn how to employ design and code to tell these stories; and they will learn how to produce, iterate and publish their projects.
